title.zh: 共同实现测试下的目标唯一性

claim.zh: 若目标由含 together 的测试分离，与同一源位置完全同测的两个目标位置相等。
claim.en: If the target is separated by tests including together, two target positions agreeing with one source position on all tests are equal.

hypotheses.zh: 使用 ExplanatoryJointness 本地 Model、Test、Same 和 Separated。
hypotheses.en: Uses the namespace-local ExplanatoryJointness Model, Test, Same and Separated.

correspondence.zh: together 检验整体的成对共同实现；不把分别成立当成共同实现。
correspondence.en: The together test concerns joint realization of a pair within a whole; separate truth is not joint realization.

detail.zh: 保留不同测试语义，不按相同声明外形合并。
detail.en: Retain distinct test semantics rather than merging by header shape.

detail.zh: 完整部分测试轮廓可能不能识别指定部分是否重复使用同一支持。
detail.en: Even complete part profiles may fail to identify whether designated parts reuse the same support.

limitations.zh: 唯一性小引理不独自证明共同计划恢复或任意指定部分可替换；相关反例保留在研究中。
limitations.en: This uniqueness lemma alone proves neither joint-plan recovery nor arbitrary substitution of designated parts; the study retains the latter boundary.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 使用共同语言时复用；具体部分替换或全局并发另需对应。
next_delta.en: Reuse for the joint language; designated-part substitution or global concurrency requires further correspondence.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
